say:1:1033441001:1.text: Because the Dark Forest is ours!
say:1:1033441001:1.source_cn: 因为薄暮丛林是我们的家园！
say:1:1033441001:1.male: Because the Dark Forest is ours!
say:1:1033441001:1.female: Because the Dark Forest is ours!

say:2:1033441002:1.text: Can you promise that all the outlanders, if permitted to enter, would cherish this forest as much as we do?
say:2:1033441002:1.source_cn: 你能保证进入丛林的外乡人都会爱护这片丛林吗？
say:2:1033441002:1.male: Can you promise that all the outlanders, if permitted to enter, would cherish this forest as much as we do?
say:2:1033441002:1.female: Can you promise that all the outlanders, if permitted to enter, would cherish this forest as much as we do?
